data.name: Kaleem
data.gender_notes: Kaleem is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who conveys the message of Allah, one who speaks the truth. The name Kaleem carries the meaning “Speaker, Talker” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kaleem usually hope their child will grow to embody speaker, talker and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To call or invite people to the path of Allah.
data.etymology: Kaleem belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Speaker, Talker.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kaleem total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: كليم
in_arabic.meaning: كليم هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني المتكلم أو المختار للكلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: كليم هو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى في الإسلام، مشتق من الكلمة العربية 'كلم' التي تعني 'المتكلم'. وفقًا للتقليد الإسلامي، يُعتبر كليم اسمًا لله الذي اختاره موسى للنطق معه، مما يجعله اسمًا ذا أهمية روحية كبيرة. في اللغة العربية، اسم كليم يعني الشخص الذي يتميز بقدرته على التعبير بوضوح وبلاغة، مما يجعله اسمًا محبوبًا بين المسلمين.

in_urdu.name: کلیم
in_urdu.meaning: کلیم ایک خوبصورت نام ہے، معنی ہے اللہ کا ایک نام، جو کہ بطور خاص موسىٰ کے ساتھ منسلک ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: کلیم (Kaleem) ایک عربی نام ہے جو کہ 'کلم' root سے بنا ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں 'المتکلم' یا 'جس کے ساتھ اللہ بولتا ہے'. اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام خاص طور پر اہل سنت والجماعہ میں معروف ہے جہاں کلیم اللہ کے 99 ناموں میں سے ایک ہے. یہ نام حضرت موسیٰ (ع) کے ساتھ منسلک ہے جس کے ساتھ اللہ تعالیٰ براہ راست بات کرتا تھا. اس نام کا استعمال عام طور پر اس کی خوبصورتی اور گہرے روحانی معنی کی وجہ سے کیا جاتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: कलीम
in_hindi.meaning: कलीम का अर्थ है परमेश्वर का एक नाम, जो विशेष रूप से मूसा के साथ जुड़ा हुआ है
in_hindi.long_meaning: कलीम (Kaleem) एक अरबी नाम है जो 'कलम' मूल से बना है, जिसका अर्थ है 'वक्ता' या 'जिसके साथ अल्लाह बात करता है'. इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम विशेष रूप से सुन्नी मुसलमानों में प्रसिद्ध है जहां कलीम अल्लाह के 99 नामों में से एक माना जाता है. यह नाम विशेष रूप से हज़रत मूसा (अस) के साथ जुड़ा हुआ है जिनके साथ अल्लाह सीधे बात करता था. इस नाम का उपयोग आमतौर पर इसकी सुंदरता और गहरे आध्यात्मिक अर्थों के कारण किया जाता है.

in_pashto.name: کليم
in_pashto.meaning: کليم د الله یو نوم دی، چې معنی یې ده هغه څوک چې ورسره الله خبرې کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: کلیم (Kaleem) په عربي ژبه کې یو نوم دی چې د 'کلم' ريښې څخه جوړ شوی دی، چې معنی یې ده 'خبرې کوونکی' یا 'هغه کس چې ورسره الله تعالیٰ خبرې کوي'. په اسلامي دود کې، دا نوم په خاصه توګه د اهل سنت والجماعه په منځ کې مشهور دی چیرته چې کلیم د الله تعالیٰ د 99 نومونو څخه يو ګڼل کیږي. دا نوم په خاصه توګه د حضرت موسیٰ (ع) سره تړلی دی چې ورسره الله تعالیٰ مستقیم خبرې کوي. دا نوم د هغې ښکلا او ژور روحاني معنی له امله عام استعمال کې دی.

in_english.name: Kaleem
in_english.meaning: Kaleem is one of the beautiful names of Allah, means the speaker or the chosen one for speaking
in_english.long_meaning: Kaleem (Kaleem) is an Arabic name derived from the root 'k-l-m', meaning 'the speaker' or 'the one with whom Allah speaks'. In Islamic tradition, particularly within Sunni Muslims, Kaleem is considered one of the 99 names of Allah. This name is especially associated with Prophet Moses (Musa), with whom Allah communicated directly. The name signifies eloquence, divine communication, and spiritual significance. It reflects qualities of wisdom, communication skills, and a deep connection with the divine. In contemporary times, Kaleem remains a revered and meaningful name across various Muslim cultures.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kaleem carries a rich cultural significance as it derives from Arabic roots meaning 'speaker', 'conveyer', or 'declarer'. Historically, in Islamic tradition, the prophets and messengers of Allah are often referred to as "Kulam Allah", the seal of all messengers. Thus, the name Kaleem can be seen to uphold these lofty connotations, implying someone who carries and delivers the words of Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Kaleem can be seen as deeply signifying the role of a human being in conveying Allah's message to the world. It emphasizes the importance of truthfulness and purpose, as one who carries the name Kaleem is encouraged to inhabit their role as a messenger sincerely and with humility, dedicating their life to serving the cause of guiding and enlightening others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Speaker, Talker" symbolizes A person who conveys the message of Allah, one who speaks the truth.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Kaleem serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of speaker, talker.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Kaleem was a famous poet during the Abbasid Caliphate in the 9th century. The name Kaleem carried significant weight in that era.

trends: used as a given name in the Muslim world
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Kaleem remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Omar Kaleem, a teacher in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, shares that their name Kaleem meaning "Speaker, Talker" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.
